title: Aetheris
description: A multi-tenant FastAPI backend for document ingestion, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation.
status: Runs locally · Public demo in progress
context: Document search combines several concerns: receiving files, processing their contents, finding relevant passages, and keeping each organization’s data isolated. Aetheris explores these concerns as a backend platform.
contribution: Built a multi-tenant ingestion and semantic-search backend with organization-scoped access, isolated services and tests, Docker infrastructure, and observability.

architecture.summary: A modular FastAPI application coordinates ingestion and retrieval. Background workers extract, chunk, and embed documents; PostgreSQL is the authoritative store, Qdrant supports vector retrieval, and MinIO stores objects.

components.name: Storage & retrieval
components.detail: PostgreSQL, MinIO, and Qdrant have distinct roles.

decisions.title: Carry organization scope through the system
decisions.description: Tenant isolation is a constraint on ingestion and retrieval, not just a UI filter. Services and their tests are organized around scoped access.

decisions.title: Process documents asynchronously
decisions.description: Extraction, chunking, embedding, and indexing run as background work. This separates long-running processing from the upload request and makes processing state part of the API contract.

decisions.title: Separate authoritative data from search indexes
decisions.description: PostgreSQL owns application records while Qdrant supports semantic retrieval and MinIO holds objects. The separation clarifies each store’s responsibility, while introducing consistency and operational work across services.

results: The public repository documents a local Docker environment and API contracts.
Its documented check commands cover formatting, linting, types, and tests; no current pass count or production benchmark is asserted here.
limitations: Operational locally, with a public online demo still in progress. No production customers, commercial adoption, or production-scale traffic is claimed.
resourceNote: The repository includes architecture, API, security, and local setup documentation. A hosted demonstration is not yet available.
